name: Deploying DeepSeek with PD Disaggregation and Large-Scale Expert Parallelism on 96 H100 GPUs, SGLang
notes: SGLang post: DeepSeek-V3 671B FP8 on 12 nodes x 8 H100 (Atlas Cloud) with PD disaggregation + large-scale EP. 52.3k input tok/s and 22.3k output tok/s per node for 2000-token inputs. Reproduction instructions at sgl-project/sglang issue 6017.
